headline: D'Youville win at Mercy to share the lead
dek: D'Youville's win at Mercy lifts them level on points with St. Thomas Aquinas at the top of the table, though St. Thomas Aquinas have a match in hand and, like Molloy, have yet to lose in conference play. D'Youville's season has turned with it: seven wins now stand against four defeats.
displaced_by: D'Youville won at Mercy on 2026-10-17 and now share the top with St. Thomas Aquinas alone; Molloy are no longer level, and the standing dek's season figures for D'Youville are out of date

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not ordered the table: Queens have scored 35, more than any other programme, while the joint leaders, D'Youville and St. Thomas Aquinas, sit in the middle of the chart.

wire.line: Molloy have drawn seven matches, more than any other side in the conference, and lost only twice.

findings.text: Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored twelve of Mercy's 33 goals from 44 shots.

last_match.line: Mercy had not lost since St. Thomas Aquinas won there on the day conference play opened; D'Youville have not lost since Molloy beat them at home.

next_match.line: Ashland are D'Youville's last opponent from outside the conference before they host Queens.
